### When Fear Overwhelms
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-22-2022.html
Passage: Numbers 14:9
Points:
- Fear and discouragement led Israel to lose perspective on the verge of the Promised Land.
- Faith and worry cannot coexist in a believer's heart, as one will drive out the other.
- The Christian life is a spiritual battleground rather than an easy playground.
- God does not call believers to retreat from their giants, but to confront them.
- Defeating daunting obstacles requires admitting personal weakness and depending on God's strength.

### Bigger than Giants, Scarier than Fear
Author: Rebekah Montgomery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/bigger-than-giants-scarier-than-fear-11552508.html
Passage: Numbers 14:9
Points:
- Fear of obstacles caused the Israelites to forget God's proven track record of deliverance.
- Believers frequently choose the comfort of familiar bondage over the risk of obeying God.
- In God's hands, seemingly insurmountable giants are reduced to easily consumed bread.
- Disobeying God is far more dangerous than facing worldly challenges or change.
- Refusing to trust God's promises leaves believers wandering in a wilderness of regret.
